items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create one square finished game card illustration for 江湖救急-改.
Input 1 is the NovelAI draft: it controls THIS composition, perspective, diagonal offering gesture, and dark blue-gray backdrop with a broad teal sweep. Input 2 is Wu's CURRENT identity reference: use her face, cyan-blue eyes, silver high ponytail, small fang smile, black round goggles on head, blue bow at high ponytail root and black rose near her left temple, black-gray off-shoulder long sleeve dress. Input 3 is 惩击: DRAWING STYLE ONLY, never copy its blonde priestess, moon ornament, clothes, gesture or light beam.
Keep the girl's face in the upper-left, leaning forward toward the viewer, one arm extending toward the lower-right foreground and offering cards. Crop the other hand and the lower skirt out. Her hand must visibly hold EXACTLY THREE separate blank ivory playing-card rectangles in one small fan: three top corners and three bottom corners, each card one simple flat rectangle, no doubled paper layers, no stack, no extra white slips. The fan is about one third the frame width. Correct the draft's excessive paper layers into this clear three-card fan. Keep fingers coherently gripping the cards, with the thumb on their near face. Make the goggles modest in scale and put the blue bow at the high ponytail root; keep the black rose on her left side near the upper temple as shown in the current identity reference. Silver hair must be long, straight and tied high, with both eyes visible. Maintain the playful confident small-fang smile.
Repaint every surface in the opaque broad-brush grammar of Input 3. Large connected matte color masses, clear hard-edged grouped shadows, a limited set of wide directional swipes and blunt dabs with handmade broken endings. Hair must be substantial coherent locks, about 4–6 main masses, with broad quiet silver base regions and only a few wide shadow turns and short irregular highlight swaths; no thin strand networks, pale scratches, tiny facets or rounded glossy hair rendering. Merge the ruffled neckline and cuffs into a few broad fold planes, retain the actual shoulder, elbow and cloth tension structure using sparse selective colored drawing. Large quiet charcoal cloth planes, not a network of small wrinkles. Anime face and cyan eyes stay selectively clear, economical nose and mouth marks, simple cheek planes, fringe cast shadow, jaw/neck turn. Hand and three-card silhouette receive the clearest drawing after the face; secondary surfaces stay coarse and quiet.
Use muted silver, charcoal, warm ivory skin and cards, with concentrated blue identity accents. Preserve Input 1's dark blue-gray and broad teal abstract background but paint it as two or three quiet opaque masses rather than polished gradients; never replace it with white. Avoid glossy 3D, smooth detailed anime lineart plus grain, all-over canvas noise, dense folds, fine hair strands, triangular mosaics, floating objects, sparkles. No text, symbols on cards, frame, watermark or UI.
items.correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing illustration only around the sunglasses and front crown/bangs. Preserve the rest exactly in content and composition: Wu's face, cyan eyes, smile with small fang, ponytail, blue ribbon, black rose, black-gray dress, hand offering three ivory cards, broad matte opaque brush painting, dark blue-gray background with teal sweep.
Replace the large thick industrial goggles with a modest pair of thin-frame ROUND BLACK SUNGLASSES resting on TOP OF THE HEAD, above and behind the front bangs. Two simple round dark lenses, slender black rims, a narrow nose bridge and thin side arms; no padding, no cylindrical lens housings, no straps, no goggle hardware, no large shiny reflections. The lenses should be about half the diameter of the existing goggle lenses. The forehead-facing fringe and both temples must remain unobstructed, with the silver front bangs visibly flowing beneath and IN FRONT OF the sunglasses. Keep both eyes completely visible. Leave the black rose and blue bow intact. Use the same broad silver hair masses, with sparse quiet shadow planes, without fine strands. Do not change the girl's facial proportions, offering hand, cards, camera, crop, palette, or backdrop. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
